channel_business_model_shift.note: Only 1 finding has a usable as_of (Q1 2026 period end, 2026-03-31; the article's own publication date was not seen). Both WebFetch calls failed (Q1 2026 press release timed out; Q2 FY2026 transcript on Yahoo returned 404), so the following leads have no verified publication date and are NOT written as claims: (a) Datadog Q1 2026 press release (investors.datadoghq.com) reportedly describes an expanded go-to-market approach aimed at the world's largest companies and most complex environments; (b) reported strategic partnership with Sakana AI covering go-to-market for enterprise AI adoption, starting with large enterprise customers in Japan; (c) reported FedRAMP High certification; (d) third-party pricing blogs (Last9, SigNoz, Better Stack, Middleware) describe Datadog as usage-based across a dozen-plus separate products with no single subscription, and a Substack piece describes ARR as contractual commitments plus usage; (e) a PartnerInsight newsletter says Datadog is in the '$2B AWS Marketplace' club (undated, secondary). Search for channel disintermediation / D2C returned only generic OpenTelemetry/ClickHouse/Grafana alternative-vendor listicles (vendor-authored, undated), with no sourced evidence of a distribution-channel shift for DDOG. Not verified: any change to the sales model, and any Q2 2026 earnings-call statement on go-to-market.
